pages.text: "Finished! I am going out!" Careless Duri brushed just twice. In front of the mirror in the classroom wash area, Duri dropped the brush into a cup without looking back.
Duri wanted to finish before Gaga, who was still brushing at the mirror. "I am already done!" Duri rushed outside.
While running happily in the yard, Duri felt a tickle between the teeth. However often a tongue pushed, it would not come out. "Oh, what is stuck?" Duri stopped.
Gaga, who knew best, came out and laughed. "Duri, green is stuck between your teeth!" Duri pressed both hands over their mouth.
Duri returned to wash. In the mirror, green from lunch was stuck between the teeth. The tickling had made play no fun.
Teacher Bau of Rainbow Class stood behind Duri and offered the toothbrush. "The brush must visit all three places. Top, bottom, inside too!" Duri took it with both hands.
Brush the top, brush the bottom, brush inside! Foam puffed up. The green piece swept out with the bubbles.
Duri rinsed and opened wide before the mirror. "Ah—" Teeth sparkled, and the tickle was gone. Tugging the purple neckerchief knot, Duri smiled widely.
After lunch the next day, Duri stayed longest at the mirror. The brush swept the top teeth. "One, brush the top! Two, brush the bottom! Three, brush inside too!"
Teacher Bau stroked Duri's head. All three places needed brushing for sparkling teeth. Showing those teeth in the mirror, Duri said, "Top, bottom, inside too!"
